crossRefs.note: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.
Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.
The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

translations.web: “By the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali, one portion.
translations.bsb: Naphtali will have one portion bordering the territory of Asher from east to west.
translations.kjv: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.
translations.asv: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, Naphtali, one portion.
